story: Discover the stunning Grey Headed Canary Flycatcher (*Culicicapa ceylonensis*), a member of the diverse Stenostiridae family. Native to Evergreen/deciduous broadleaf forest; bamboo; mixed forest; forest edge; and streamsides, this bird faces various environmental challenges. Currently classified as Least Concern (LC) on the IUCN Red List, the Grey Headed Canary Flycatcher represents the delicate balance of its native region. Understanding its habitat requirements and distribution is key to effective conservation planning. This species contributes to the richness of avian diversity, and this poster offers an artistic glimpse into its world.
